title: Complete scan of an input suffix
statement: Let $S$ be a finite set with decidable equality, let $\delta:S\times\{0,1\}\to S$ be a transition function, let $s_0\in S$ be a starting state, and let $A:S\to\{0,1\}$ be an acceptance predicate. For all Boolean words $x$ and $r$, every prefix $p$ satisfying $x=p\mathbin{+s}r$, and every state $q\in S$, the scanner started on $x$ in state $q$ with its input head just after $p$ is halted after $|r|+1$ steps and has output $[A(\operatorname{foldl}(\delta,q,r))]$.
replaced:
Let the input decompose as $x = p \mathbin{+\!\!+} r$. Started in any state $q$ at
position $|p|$, the one-way scanner halts after exactly $|r| + 1$ steps with output
the single bit obtained by applying the accepting predicate to the fold of the
transition over $r$ from $q$; no earlier step emits.
